physicalNotes: Radius 0.546 +/- 0.022 solar radii from Rowe et al. 2014, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Kepler-205 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014ApJ...784...45R/abstract): 379,852 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.669 +/- 0.072599 solar masses from TICv8, the stellar mass of Kepler-205 c's parameter set from TICv8 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4321 +/- 100 K from Rowe et al. 2014, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-205 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014ApJ...784...45R/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
